about_the_game:
GodsTV thrusts players into a deranged game show at the edges of the multiverse in this madcap Action RPG with rogue-like elements. Play as a motley crew of Contenders Solo or Co-op as you fight your way up to galactic Mega Stardom.

A DEAL WITH (A) GOD

Earn the favor of a God, grow stronger, and expand your divine brand accross dimensions. Weapons, skills, power-ups—everything is a product the Gods are advertising, the more famous you become the cooler gear you get to brag about. So make their products shine and rise to become the disgustingly rich celeb you secretly dream to be.

CHASING STARDOM

Upon death you’ll revive in the Backstage, where you must check in with your AI-Gent, shake on the shadiest deals and romance an NPC or two to gain followers and unleash your God’s Gifts.

CRUSH THE COMPETITION

Fight through the levels and violent TV events where ratings are all that matters, Rival contenders will get in your way, defeat them, steal their followers and sacrifice them to your God.

RAGS TO (FILTHY) RICHES

The road to Stardom won’t be easy, master your Gifts, unlock Signature Weapons, expand your fanbase to absurd limits on your path to become the GodsTV GOAST (Greatest of All Space Time, duh!).
